items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Seems to me Gino told me about somebody... Do you remember Jip the Blood...

ctx.x: I don't think so. I don't remember.
Seems to me Gino told me about somebody. We can ask him about it. Uh-huh. Somebody with a similar name, maybe a relative or something. Do you remember Jip the Blood when they had that killing?
Oh, yes. That's, that's, that's, that's, uh, I didn't know much about him, but I, I remember the time, you know, when he, when he did do all that killing.

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: the Italian fella there, uh, uh, on the corner of, uh, of, uh, of Bauer and Gravy, he was the one that sent off and got a little wonder for me, see, kind of banjo.

ctx.x: Oh, I never did get straight. Uh, which instrument did you play first? Guitar, mandolin, or banjo?

Well, in fact, I'll tell you the truth, I believe I did start on the guitar first, but I, I, I, I, I played, I practically was playing both of them most at the same time, you see, because I could play guitar pretty good. Mm-hmm. And banjos, when they, a long time ago, the banjo came out behind the guitar. Mm-hmm. That's the way the banjos did, they come out behind the guitar. So I played guitar first, when, if you, if you, if you, if you do right, they say right, I play, I play the guitar first. Cause I remember…
But when did you play mandolin?
